def _build_code_block(
    diff: str, budget_chars: int, *, asset_views: dict[str, str] | None = None
) -> tuple[str, CoverageStatus, tuple[FileCoverage, ...], int, int]:
    files = _split_diff_files(diff)
    if not files:
        if diff.strip():
            return "(diff unavailable)", "unavailable", (), 0, 0
        block = _cap_prompt_text(diff, max(1, budget_chars // TOKEN_CHARS))
        status: CoverageStatus = "complete" if block == diff else "truncated"
        return block, status, (), min(len(diff), len(block)), len(diff)
    if any(path is None for path, _ in files):
        return "(diff unavailable)", "unavailable", (), 0, 0
    # Doc-Lineage#81 review finding (discussion_r4169521235): appending
    # omitted paths after fair-share allocation exceeded the diff budget.
    # Fit text first, then use spare budget for a count-only diagnostic.
    # Omitted paths remain in FileCoverage metadata and still prevent PASS.
    asset_views = asset_views or {}
    sizes = [
        (
            len(text) + len(asset_views.get(path, ""))
            if path in asset_views or not _diff_file_is_binary_descriptor(text)
            else 0
        )
        for path, text in files
    ]
    # A complete single-file unit is the minimum meaningful code input. The
    # rough grouping budget bounds optional packing, not model capacity. Its
    # actual fully assembled request must still pass the shared native counter.
    # Unknown binary descriptors keep their existing zero-byte omission.
    if len(files) == 1 and sizes[0]:
        budget_chars = max(budget_chars, sizes[0])
    omission_note = "[{count} changed file(s) omitted entirely — not shown to the reviewer]\n"
    shares = _fair_shares(sizes, max(0, budget_chars))
    parts: list[str] = []
    coverage: list[FileCoverage] = []
    omitted = 0
    for (path, text), share in zip(files, shares, strict=True):
        assert path is not None  # Parse failures were rejected above.
        excerpt, item = _excerpt_file(path, text, share, asset_view=asset_views.get(path, ""))
        coverage.append(item)
        if excerpt:
            parts.append(excerpt)
        else:
            omitted += 1
    if omitted:
        note_budget = max(0, budget_chars - sum(len(part) for part in parts))
        parts.append(omission_note.format(count=omitted)[:note_budget])
    included = sum(item.included_chars for item in coverage)
    total = sum(item.total_chars for item in coverage)
    status = "complete" if all(item.status == "complete" for item in coverage) else "truncated"
    return "".join(parts).rstrip("\n"), status, tuple(coverage), included, total
recorded_symbols._acceptance_criteria_sections:
def _acceptance_criteria_sections(plan_sources: str) -> str:
    """Return only acceptance-criteria subsections from structured plan sources."""
    lines: list[str] = []
    fence_char: str | None = None
    fence_len = 0
    fence_indent = 0
    for raw_line in plan_sources.splitlines():
        fence = _code_fence_marker(raw_line)
        if fence:
            marker, closing, indent = fence
            if fence_char is None:
                fence_char = marker[0]
                fence_len = len(marker)
                fence_indent = indent
            elif (
                marker[0] == fence_char
                and len(marker) >= fence_len
                and closing
                and indent <= max(3, fence_indent)
            ):
                fence_char = None
                fence_len = 0
                fence_indent = 0
            lines.append("")
            continue
        lines.append("" if fence_char is not None else raw_line)
    captured: list[str] = []
    index = 0
    while index < len(lines):
        heading = re.match(
            r"^(#{1,6})\s+acceptance[\s_-]*criteria\s*:?[\s]*$",
            lines[index].strip(),
            flags=re.I,
        )
        if not heading:
            index += 1
            continue
        level = len(heading.group(1))
        section: list[str] = []
        index += 1
        while index < len(lines):
            next_heading = re.match(r"^(#{1,6})\s+", lines[index].strip())
            if next_heading and len(next_heading.group(1)) <= level:
                break
            section.append(lines[index])
            index += 1
        captured.append("\n".join(section).strip())
    return "\n\n".join(part for part in captured if part)
recorded_symbols._create_followup_issue:
def _create_followup_issue(
    result: EvaluationResult,
    context: str,
    *,
    labels: list[str],
    run_url: str | None,
) -> int | None:
    if not _should_create_issue(result):
        return None

    token = os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN")
    repo = os.environ.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY")
    if not token or not repo:
        return None

    pr_number, pr_url = _extract_pr_metadata(context)
    body = _format_followup_issue_body(
        result,
        pr_number=pr_number,
        pr_url=pr_url,
        run_url=run_url,
    )
    title = "LLM evaluation concerns"
    if pr_number:
        title = f"LLM evaluation concerns for PR #{pr_number}"

    try:
        issue = api_client.create_issue(repo, token, title, body, labels)
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        print(f"pr_verifier: failed to create follow-up issue: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return None

    issue_number = issue.get("number")
    if isinstance(issue_number, int):
        return issue_number
    return None

def test_split_diff_files_decodes_quoted_escapes_and_rejects_malformed_headers():
    valid_diff = (
        'diff --git "a/dir/\\141\\t\\"\\\\file.py" "b/dir/\\141\\t\\"\\\\file.py"\n'
        '--- "a/dir/\\141\\t\\"\\\\file.py"\n'
        '+++ "b/dir/\\141\\t\\"\\\\file.py"\n'
        "@@ -1 +1 @@\n-old\n+new\n"
    )
    parsed = verifier._split_diff_files(valid_diff)
    assert len(parsed) == 1
    assert parsed[0][0] == 'dir/a\t"\\file.py'

    for invalid_header in (
        'diff --git "a/\\377.py" "b/\\377.py"\n',
        'diff --git "a/dangling\\',
        'diff --git "a/\\12x.py" "b/\\12x.py"\n',
        'diff --git "a/\\400.py" "b/\\400.py"\n',
        'diff --git "a/\\z.py" "b/\\z.py"\n',
        'diff --git "a/file.py"trailing "b/file.py"\n',
        'diff --git "a/file.py" "b/file.py"trailing\n',
        'diff --git "x/file.py" "b/file.py"\n',
        'diff --git a/file.py b/file.py\n--- a/file.py\n+++ "b/\\z.py"\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-a\n+b\n',
    ):
        files = verifier._split_diff_files(invalid_header)
        assert files[0][0] is None
        block, status, coverage, included, total = verifier._build_code_block(invalid_header, 500)
        assert (block, status, coverage, included, total) == (
            "(diff unavailable)",
            "unavailable",
            (),
            0,
            0,
        )

    empty_block, empty_status, empty_cov, empty_inc, empty_tot = verifier._build_code_block("", 100)
    assert (empty_block, empty_status, empty_cov, empty_inc, empty_tot) == (
        "",
        "complete",
        (),
        0,
        0,
    )

    summary = "\n".join(
        [
            "### Overview",
            "- ignored/before.py (+1/-0)",
            "### File changes",
            '- `a.py` (+2/-1) <!-- verifier-file-path:v1 "src/a.py" -->',

        '### File changes\n- `empty` <!-- verifier-file-path:v1 "" -->',
        "### File changes\n- `unclosed` <!-- verifier-file-path:v1 unquoted -->",
    ):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="encoded summary destination"):
            verifier._summary_destination_paths(bad_line)

def test_acceptance_criteria_sections_ignores_fenced_headings_and_stops_at_peer_heading():
    plan_sources = "\n".join(
        [
            "# Plan",
            "```markdown",
            "## Acceptance Criteria",
            "- [ ] Fake criterion inside code fence",
            "```not-a-closing-fence",
            "```",
            "## Acceptance Criteria",
            "- [ ] First real criterion",
            "### Sub-heading kept inside section",
            "- [ ] Second real criterion",
            "## Implementation Notes",
            "- [ ] Not an acceptance criterion",
        ]
    )
    extracted = verifier._acceptance_criteria_sections(plan_sources)
    assert "Fake criterion" not in extracted

        "### Sub-heading kept inside section\n"
        "- [ ] Second real criterion"
    )

def test_followup_issue_formatting_and_creation_paths(monkeypatch, capsys):
    result = verifier.EvaluationResult(
        verdict="CONCERNS",
        summary="",
        concerns=["", "Missing edge-case test"],
        error="Provider timeout on secondary check",
    )
    body = verifier._format_followup_issue_body(
        result,
        pr_number=None,
        pr_url=None,
        run_url="https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/actions/runs/99",
    )
    assert "- Verdict: CONCERNS" in body
    assert "- Summary:" not in body
    assert "- Missing edge-case test" in body
    assert "## Evaluation Error\nProvider timeout on secondary check" in body
    assert "- PR:" not in body
    assert "- Evaluation run: https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/actions/runs/99" in body

    assert verifier._create_followup_issue(result, "context", labels=["bug"], run_url=None) is None

    monkeypatch.setattr(verifier, "_should_create_issue", lambda _res: True)
    monkeypatch.delenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", raising=False)
    monkeypatch.delenv("GITHUB_REPOSITORY", raising=False)
    assert verifier._create_followup_issue(result, "context", labels=["bug"], run_url=None) is None

    monkeypatch.setenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "tok")
    monkeypatch.setenv("GITHUB_REPOSITORY", "stranske/Workflows")
    captured_calls = []

    def fake_create_issue(repo, token, title, issue_body, labels):
        captured_calls.append((repo, token, title, issue_body, labels))
        return {"number": 4321}

    monkeypatch.setattr(verifier.api_client, "create_issue", fake_create_issue)
    issue_num = verifier._create_followup_issue(
        result,
        "Pull request: [#88](https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/pull/88)",
        labels=["verifier"],
        run_url="https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/actions/runs/99",
    )
    assert issue_num == 4321
    assert captured_calls[-1][2] == "LLM evaluation concerns for PR #88"

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        verifier.api_client,
        "create_issue",
        lambda *_args: {"number": "not-an-int"},
    )
    assert (
        verifier._create_followup_issue(result, "no pr metadata", labels=[], run_url=None) is None
    )

    def raising_create_issue(*_args):
        raise RuntimeError("API 503")

    monkeypatch.setattr(verifier.api_client, "create_issue", raising_create_issue)
    assert (
        verifier._create_followup_issue(result, "no pr metadata", labels=[], run_url=None) is None
    )
    assert "failed to create follow-up issue: API 503" in capsys.readouterr().err
